name: luna16
title: LUNA16: 888 thoracic CTs (LIDC-IDRI subset) for lung nodule detection
description: The LUNA16 challenge scans: 888 CTs from LIDC-IDRI with slice thickness <= 2.5 mm, as MetaImage (.mhd + .raw), in ten subsets for cross-validation. Each subset is a 6-7 GB zip on Zenodo read scan by scan with HTTP Range (the .raw sibling is fetched with its header). Nodule annotations (annotations.csv, candidates.csv) are separate files on the Zenodo record.

license.note: CC BY 4.0 on the Zenodo records (checked 2026-10-14); the underlying LIDC-IDRI collection is CC BY 3.0 (TCIA).

citation: Setio A.A.A., Traverso A., de Bel T., et al. Validation, comparison, and combination of algorithms for automatic detection of pulmonary nodules in computed tomography images: the LUNA16 challenge. Med Image Anal 42:1-13, 2017.

ct.description: Thorax CT (MetaImage header + raw; LPS mm from the header); field subset = fold 0..9
